fields.name: MapShardKeyAttribute property-mapping contract
fields.contract: MapShardKeyAttribute is an abstract attribute applicable to one property only. Its construction retains a shard parameter, record, child, grandchild, and great-grandchild column names, plus the record-identifier flag, as metadata for mapping a Virtual compound key. ShardIdName exposes the associated Shard identifier parameter's ColumnName when a shard parameter is present; otherwise it exposes null. The attribute exposes the retained shard parameter without mutation.
